task_title: SPEC: board analytics + HTML report — data contracts, derivations, UX, ACs
task_criteria: Deliverable: docs/specs/board-analytics-report.md exists and is implementation-ready. Must contain: (1) data contracts derived ONLY from tasks.jsonl + events.jsonl + board.jsonl header (no git/repo access) incl. the real 32-key task union, sparse-key tolerance, dual timestamp parsing (2006-01-02 15:04:05 AND RFC3339), fixture exclusion rule (id NEVER-DONE* or perpetual:true excluded from burndown/velocity/streaks, visible behind a toggle); (2) view catalog where each view names the user question it answers (burndown, burn-up, weekly velocity, cycle-time median/p90/worst5, streaks, tick-health timeline, work clock weekday-hour, model share, multi-board compare); (3) non-gameable streak semantics (DeliveryStreak = consecutive days with >=1 real task completion = headline; ActivityStreak = days with any non-noise event; raw any-tick streak context-only); (4) UX spec: overview card grid -> project page -> collapse-first task rows with in-place expand, expand/collapse-all, text/status/fixture filters, URL-hash addressable rows; (5) hard constraints: single self-contained HTML, inline CSS/JS, zero CDN (works from file://), hand-rolled SVG charts, JSON island payload with </ escaped; (6) explicit testable acceptance criteria sections for BT-020 (render), BT-021 (serve), BT-022 (import). Repo gates stay green (go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1 -short).
